signals.title: IBM turns agent evaluation metrics into continuously recorded governance enforcement evidence
signals.title_zh: IBM 将 Agent 评估指标转化为持续记录的治理执行证据
signals.summary: IBM watsonx.governance Enforcement Tracking for watsonx Orchestrate automatically collects agent-evaluation metrics, associates them with governance controls and thresholds, and records pass or breach evidence so policy enforcement can be continuously evidenced rather than merely documented.
signals.summary_zh: IBM watsonx.governance Enforcement Tracking for watsonx Orchestrate 会自动采集 Agent 评估指标，将其关联到治理控制与阈值，并记录通过或违反证据，使策略执行可以被持续证明，而不是只停留在文档声明。

researchValue.failure: A documented policy or configured control does not prove that a production agent is continuously operating within it.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind scheduled or on-demand agent evaluation metrics to governance controls and thresholds, then persist pass or breach results as enforcement evidence.
researchValue.implication: Governed digital-employee platforms should distinguish declared policy from continuously refreshed evidence that the running agent satisfies that policy.

signals.title: Codex binds macOS MCP user verification to biometric-protected Secure Enclave credentials and cancellation-safe signing
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 macOS MCP 用户验证绑定到生物识别保护的 Secure Enclave 凭据与取消安全的签名路径
signals.summary: Codex implemented native macOS user verification with P-256 Secure Enclave keys protected by biometric access control, a fresh authentication context per signature, cross-process credential serialization, cancellable lock waits, authentication invalidation on cancellation, and late-result rejection tests.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 实现了原生 macOS 用户验证：使用受生物识别访问控制保护的 P-256 Secure Enclave 密钥，每次签名创建新的认证上下文，跨进程序列化凭据操作，锁等待可取消；取消时使待处理认证失效，并用测试拒绝迟到结果。

researchValue.failure: User-verification protocols can become unsafe when proof is detached from a protected device credential or when cancellation races allow stale authentication results to survive.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind each verification signature to a biometric-protected Secure Enclave credential and fresh authentication context; serialize credential operations and close cancellation before releasing the signer lock.
researchValue.implication: Human approval evidence for digital employees should bind the approving human, protected credential, concrete challenge, and cancellation lifecycle instead of treating a UI confirmation as sufficient proof.

signals.title: Agent memory can remain durable while becoming semantically non-portable across model upgrades
signals.title_zh: Agent 记忆可以保持持久化，却在模型升级后失去语义可移植性
signals.summary: A controlled study finds that fixed-schema knowledge-graph memory transfers almost unchanged across writer swaps, while natural-language notes and embedding indexes can shift materially and asymmetrically after model or embedding upgrades; source history materially improves recoverability.
signals.summary_zh: 一项受控研究发现，固定 Schema 的知识图谱记忆在 Writer 替换后几乎保持不变，而自然语言 Notes 与 Embedding Index 在模型或 Embedding 升级后可能出现明显且方向不对称的变化；保留源历史能显著提高恢复能力。

researchValue.failure: A memory store can remain physically durable while its retrieval semantics change after a model or embedding upgrade, creating silent behavioral drift.
researchValue.finding: The study reports nearly stable fixed-schema transfer, but direction-dependent changes for natural-language notes and partial recovery from mixed embedding indexes; retaining raw source history substantially improves recovery.
researchValue.mechanism: Use structured schemas where possible, preserve source history, isolate embedding spaces, fully re-embed when required, and test migration in both model-upgrade directions.
researchValue.implication: A digital employee model upgrade should re-admit memory as a migrated capability with evidence, not assume that the same durable store preserves the same operational meaning.

signals.title: Role-matched agents are not automatically interchangeable after a team has formed coordination conventions
signals.title_zh: 角色匹配的 Agent 在团队形成协作惯例后并不会自动保持可替换性
signals.summary: Controlled team-swap experiments find that replacing a role-matched agent can preserve much of task score while increasing communication cost per unit of progress by 16–63%; in Hanabi, a swapped agent can be costlier than an inexperienced one because the original team accumulated coordination conventions.
signals.summary_zh: 受控团队替换实验发现，替换角色匹配的 Agent 往往能保留大部分任务得分，但单位进展的沟通成本会上升 16–63%；在 Hanabi 中，替换 Agent 甚至可能比无经验 Agent 成本更高，因为原团队已经形成了协作惯例。

researchValue.failure: Treating agents as fungible because they share the same nominal role ignores team-specific conventions and can create hidden coordination debt during replacement or recovery.
researchValue.finding: The study reports a 16–63% increase in communication cost per progress after role-matched swaps, with longer team formation histories increasing the swap penalty in tested settings.
researchValue.mechanism: Evaluate replacement agents against coordination compatibility and, when needed, perform an explicit team re-formation or handoff phase rather than only checking role capability.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee staffing, failover and recovery should treat team membership as stateful organizational context rather than assume that a role label is sufficient replacement authority.

signals.title: Hybrid GUI+CLI agent benchmarks expose one shared execution state across two control surfaces
signals.title_zh: GUI+CLI 混合 Agent 基准揭示了两个控制界面背后的同一共享执行状态
signals.summary: CUA-Universe builds reproducible desktop VMs with both GUI and command-line surfaces over the same applications, synthesizes hybrid tasks and verified trajectories, and reports substantial success and efficiency gains after training a 9B model on the environment.
signals.summary_zh: CUA-Universe 为同一批桌面应用构建可复现 VM，并同时提供 GUI 与命令行控制界面，生成混合任务与可验证轨迹；在该环境训练 9B 模型后，论文报告了明显的成功率与执行效率提升。

researchValue.failure: GUI-only or CLI-only evaluation can miss cross-surface side effects and inefficient trajectories because both interfaces mutate the same underlying application state.
researchValue.finding: The paper reports large gains in task success and reductions in steps and tokens on hybrid and external computer-use benchmarks after training in its reproducible environment.
researchValue.mechanism: Package real applications into reproducible VMs, expose coordinated GUI and CLI surfaces, synthesize hybrid tasks, and validate trajectories against shared application state.
researchValue.implication: Computer-use governance and verification should bind GUI and CLI actions into one effect/provenance chain because changing control modality does not create a separate business state.
